source: 이번 에이전트 실행 / 사용자 전달 결과와 별개
command:
import datetime,hashlib,json,pathlib
root=pathlib.Path.cwd(); original=json.loads((root/'logs/original_inventory.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')); comparisons=[]
for name,before in original['files'].items():
    p=root/name; after=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if p.exists() else None
    comparisons.append({'file':name,'before':before,'after':after,'unchanged':before==after})
record={'source':'이번 에이전트 최종 원본 보존 확인','recorded_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone(datetime.timedelta(hours=9))).isoformat(),'timezone':'Asia/Seoul','original_file_count':len(comparisons),'all_original_files_unchanged':all(x['unchanged'] for x in comparisons),'comparisons':comparisons,'git_configured':False,'git_diff_check':'해당 없음: Git 미설정'}
with (root/'logs/final_preservation.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(record,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
print(json.dumps({'original_file_count':len(comparisons),'all_original_files_unchanged':record['all_original_files_unchanged']},ensure_ascii=False))
assert record['all_original_files_unchanged']
replay=json.loads(next((root/'logs').glob('replay_*.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
print(json.dumps({k:replay[k] for k in ['started_at','finished_at','completed_repeats','frame_count','frame_ids','expected_points_comparison','original_files_unchanged']},ensure_ascii=False))
